'''Holcolo''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. One of Holcolo's friends reprogrammed [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s to abduct local gentry throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
